sum: Eagle Point Credit Company is a closed ended fund launched and managed by Eagle Point Credit Management LLC. It invests in fixed income markets of the United States. The fund invests equity and junior debt tranches of collateralized loan obligations consisting primarily of below investment grade U.S. senior secured loans. Eagle Point Credit Company was formed on March 24, 2014 and is domiciled in the United States.
ceo: Mr. Thomas Philip Majewski CPA (CEO & Interested Director)
